parsed.why: Court-upheld criminalisation, no non-discrimination law, no LGBT infrastructure; cross-dresser attacks and a fraud charge for presenting as a woman show presentation-based exposure, but no police coercion or tourist-targeting record.

Constitutional SOGI protection, self-ID, marriage, protected pride marches — but birth-sex prison placement with documented deaths, sexual violence and inadequate official response to killings amid conflict.

Enforced criminalisation plus a criminalised advocacy offence; 2023 cross-dressing conviction, police sexual coercion, tourist-targeting policing and impunity combine state and street hostility with no recourse.

No criminalisation, functioning courts and supranational rulings finding breach; but official demonisation, assembly restriction and the document-erosion architecture. Visitor document friction is an open question, not a documented exposure.

Rarely enforced life-imprisonment statute used as a police extortion lever, patterned trans violence with justice failure and no hate-crime law — offset by 72% acceptance, struck-down cross-dress ban and pledged decriminalisation.
